page: City page: B2B lead generation Tokyo (/b2b-lead-generation-tokyo)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Tokyo?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to Tokyo work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the Tokyo market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for Tokyo built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with Tokyo buyers, mainly manufacturers, trading houses, IT and pharma companies. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into Japan. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in Tokyo. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in Tokyo and send in their working hours. Tokyo is 3.5 hours ahead of India, so messages go out on Japanese weekday mornings and meetings fit the Indian morning. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for Tokyo buyers?
items.answer: Japan's Act on the Regulation of Transmission of Specified Electronic Mail generally requires consent for advertising email, with exceptions such as business addresses a company publishes. Its APPI governs personal data. Campaigns are scoped with you, and with counsel, before launch. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
